about.en: USDm (MegaUSD) is MegaETH's native US dollar stablecoin, issued through Ethena's stablecoin stack. Its MegaETH contract is 0xFAfDdbb3FC7688494971a79cc65DCa3EF82079E7 (Ethereum: 0xEc2AF1C8B110a61fD9C3Fa6a554a031Ca9943926). The USDM ticker is reused by unrelated tokens (Mountain Protocol's USDM, Mento Dollar), so match it by contract, not by symbol.
